name: Every cut has a job
status: MARKET CANDIDATE · NOT DEPLOYED OR FUNDED
post: Every cut has a job. Explore the 9% base sell-fee split, bounded surge and finite reserve design in Omertà Market. Implementation candidate; not deployed or funded. LP fees are additional. Follow @OmertaOnRH.

title: EVERY CUT
HAS A JOB.
slides.sub: Follow the canonical market’s fee flow.

title: FOUR ORDERS.
ONE BASE FEE.
slides.sub: 9% is the total base sell fee.
slides.note: LP fees are additional. Other pools have their own policies.

title: PRESSURE
LEAVES A TRACE.
slides.sub: Extra sell pressure can add a bounded charge.
slides.note: Pressure decays over time. Buys cannot instantly reset it.

title: FUNDING
HAS A DESTINATION.
slides.note: Funding does not reset lifetime deployment limits.

title: NO BOTTOMLESS
VAULT.
slides.sub: Reserves use finite inventory and explicit limits.
slides.note: No guaranteed floor, promised yield or MEV immunity.

title: THE CITY
KEEPS ACCOUNTS.
slides.sub: See the whole system in the film.
slides.note: Hook rules and companion contracts have separate responsibilities.

name: The wreck is a beginning
post: The wreck is a beginning. Omertà’s World Graph connects salvage, conserved materials, crafting and item history. Phase 1 is implemented and OMR-neutral. Phase 2A remains in development; NFT export is not live.

title: THE WRECK IS
A BEGINNING.
slides.sub: An object can be the start of another story.

title: START WITH
WHAT EXISTS.
slides.sub: Salvage consumes an eligible car once.
slides.note: This is a conceptual flow, not a universal yield recipe.

title: KEEP TRACK
OF THE MATERIAL.
slides.sub: The item ledger is inventory authority.
slides.note: Collection status is separate from actual inventory.

title: CRAFT FROM
REAL INPUTS.
slides.sub: Graph-defined recipes declare what they consume.
slides.note: Phase 1 is OMR-neutral. Hardened steel has a $300 game-cash sink.

title: THE OBJECT
KEEPS ITS HISTORY.
slides.sub: Unique identity and custody remain recorded.
slides.note: Default inventory is off-chain. NFT export is not live.

title: FOLLOW
THE CONNECTIONS.
slides.sub: Next: a deeper materials and salvage system.
slides.note: Immutable definitions, material lots and expanded salvage are next.

name: No one has the whole story
status: PHASES 00–01 IMPLEMENTED · API PILOTS DEFAULT OFF
post: No one has the whole story. The Split Ledger needs original evidence from two different accounts. Share deliberately; copies cannot manufacture independence. Coordination Phases 00–01 are implemented for review. Value-neutral API pilots default off.

title: NO ONE HAS
THE WHOLE STORY.
slides.note: The Dead Letter + The Split Ledger

title: THE DOCKS
HAS ONE HALF.
slides.sub: One investigator discovers a local source.
slides.note: The Split Ledger uses server-required district sources.

title: THE FOUNDRY
HAS THE OTHER.
slides.sub: A different account discovers the second source.
slides.note: One account collecting both sources does not supply independence.

title: SHARE
DELIBERATELY.
items: Choose an account, Crew or Family
slides.note: Permissions are rechecked when evidence is read or used.

title: TWO SOURCES.
ONE CONCLUSION.
slides.sub: Independent original evidence unlocks the gate.
slides.note: Copies, personal archives and player assertions add no new source.

title: CONNECT
THE EVIDENCE.
slides.sub: Explore what is built. Follow what comes next.
slides.note: Delegation, economic adapters and AI generation remain planned.
